data_provenance: GMAC GMAT Focus Edition structure (live since Feb 2024): 3 equally-weighted section-adaptive sections — Quantitative Reasoning 21Q/45m, Verbal Reasoning 23Q/45m, Data Insights 20Q/45m. Total 64 questions / 2h15m. Confirm against mba.com before production use.
important_caveat: GMAT Focus is section-adaptive (difficulty chosen live). Seeded pattern totals describe section size and bank planning, not a fixed-form paper mix.

exam_day.note: Single computer-adaptive test. Candidate chooses section order (6 possible sequences). Optional 10-min break between sections.

Paper_1.label: GMAT Focus Edition
Paper_1.overall_difficulty: Section-adaptive; bank items should span low–high

section_1_single_correct.note: Full Focus paper is 5-option single-correct style (Quant/Verbal) plus DI interactive formats treated as scored singles for bank planning. Per-section sizes in all_subjects_table: Quant 21 / Verbal 23 / DI 20.

marking.note: No JEE-style −1 per wrong. Adaptive IRT scoring 60–90 per section; Total 205–805. Unanswered end-of-section items are heavily penalized.

question_types_note: GMAT Focus uses 5-option single-correct MCQ in Quant/Verbal. Data Insights adds Table Analysis, Graphics Interpretation, Two-Part Analysis, Multi-Source Reasoning, and Data Sufficiency. No JEE-style numerical entry.
